 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width / full-height uniform lines form the grid separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def spans(size, separators):
        cuts = [-1] + separators + [size]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts) - 1)
                if cuts[i] + 1 < cuts[i + 1]]

    row_spans = spans(h, sep_rows)
    col_spans = spans(w, sep_cols)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            background = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
            out_row.append(1 if sum(v != background for v in vals) > 1 else 0)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
"
}
